column1: # Files Riceforge places in your home directory. Read by install/user-config.sh,
# mode   source (relative to the repo)   target (relative to $HOME)    TAB separated
#   link  target becomes a symlink to ~/.config/riceforge/<source>; anything already
#         there is moved into the install backup first
#   seed  copied only when the target does not exist; yours to edit afterwards
# Targets through `current` follow the active theme (current -> themes/<name>).
